name: Battery Health & Power
author: nertwork
description: Comprehensive battery health management, live Apple Silicon SMC & ThinkPad RAPL/dGPU wattage telemetry (even on AC), configurable bar display modes (both, percentage, usage), 80%/100% charge threshold limiting, and power profile switching in a native Omarchy bar panel.

barWidget.description: Battery status, charge limit toggle (80%/100%), power profiles, and energy analytics
